rubric_items.reason: CO-1 to CO-7 are built as designed: count FILTER query with no limit, upcoming = SCHEDULED and starts_at > now, latest COMPLETED by starts_at DESC, id DESC, localDay day, date-only link, plain doctor name. CO-8 and CO-9 are left unchanged.
SQL stays in the repository, rules in the service, camelCase response field (A-04), web types mirror the API types. No new routes, migrations or logging.
7 files, all named by the design, 113 added and 3 deleted lines. The only change outside the design is narrowing the PatientRepo.get return type, which the build fix needs.
Unknown id still throws notFound before the summary queries run. Null lastVisit, zero counts, no appointments, id tie-break and hospital-local day are all handled. No new endpoint.
The summary and Changes list match the diff file by file. Two small inaccuracies: the service reads the clock twice in get, and the design does not say it wants no regression test.

findings.text: The summary says PatientService.get reads the clock once, but get calls this.today(), which reads the clock, and then this.clock() again for now. Only appointments and visitSummary share one reading.
findings.suggested_fix: Reword: get reads `now` once and shares it between appointments and visitSummary.

findings.text: The summary says the design asks for no regression test, but the design says nothing about tests. Its only mention is that the time-zone rule stays in one tested place and S-3 AC2 can be asserted on the API.

cites.quote: No tests are added: the design asks for no regression test.
can be asserted exactly on the API

findings.suggested_fix: State that the design does not ask for tests in this step and the unit-test step covers S-3 AC2, rather than saying the design asks for none.
